not_taken._comment: Team photographs found at the same source but not installed, and why. Recorded so the search is not repeated and the reasoning stays auditable.
not_taken.team_2000_01: 1440x928. Shows a #40 where archive.json records #42 (Jason Parker) for 2000-01 and lists no #40; Jules Camara wore #40 in 1999-00 and 2001-02 but is absent from the 2000-01 roster. Twelve of thirteen numbers match. Not installed: the season cannot be asserted from the archive's own data.
not_taken.team_2001_02: 1436x960. Contains a #00 that appears on no roster in the covered era, and 2001-02's #22 and #33 are unaccounted for. Not installed pending identification.
not_taken.team_2004_05: 1384x876. Fifteen of the sixteen 2004-05 numbers present; #11 does not appear in the frame. Not installed pending confirmation that the player was simply absent from the sitting.
not_taken.team_2006_07: 1380x868, which is smaller than the 1500x993 original already held. No gain.
